site_name: Stack Infrastructure (formerly Infomart, formerly Fortune Data Centers), 8135 NE Evergreen Parkway, formerly 21515 NW Evergreen Parkway, Hillsboro
utility_evidence_kind: local map with a utility page
utility_evidence_period: the layer as queried 2026-11-15 (it cites the commission's allocation order); the city's page as read 2026-11-15
notes: Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). The Oregon Public Utility Commission's territory-allocation layer ('EnergyBaseMap'), queried by the session at the site's coordinates, returns one area: NAME 'PGE', PUC_ORDER '39026'. The City of Hillsboro's own page on data centers: 'In Hillsboro, power for data centers is primarily provided and monitored by Portland General Electric (PGE).' Accepted at medium under D-48's rule for a map read at the coordinates with a page of the municipality. 'Primarily' leaves room for another supplier in the city; the regulator's layer shows none at this point. Also a site statement: Fortune Data Centers' release of 13 December 2011 about its Hillsboro data center, 'Power to the facility is supplied by Portland General Electric (PGE)'. The tie to this row: a builder's project page calls the facility 'Infomart (formerly Fortune Data Centers) Oregon 1'; Oregon DEQ's 2018 review report for permit 34-0183-SI-01 has Infomart operating a data center at 21515 NW Evergreen Parkway, 'built in 2011'; and DEQ's 2025 penalty notice cites the same permit for Stack's data center at 8135 NE Evergreen Parkway.
